action.objective: Complete broad search over all four legal root moves to find the best escape from the knight check.
action.rationale: Position is in check from the d3 knight (Nf4-d3+). White has four legal king/queen moves: Qd4xd3 (d4d3), Kf1, Kg1, Kg3. Black's queen on e4 and rooks on b7/e8 are active, and Black has a protected passed pawn threat. Need full-depth-4 broad coverage before selecting.
